name: TableTruncationTeardown
summary: Empties the tables the tests filled, so that a run starts from a state nothing left behind.

roles.name: TableTruncationTeardown
roles.summary: The blunt teardown: it removes everything rather than tracking what was added. It is fast and it is total, which is the trade — it will empty a table a colleague's fixture was relying on just as happily, so what it truncates is a decision worth reading rather than inferring.
